name: Remnant Marine
desc: A Concord marine who never stopped following orders, in armor kept like new.

intro: A marine in spotless Concord plate challenges you by the book, asks for your authorization, and doesn't wait long for it.
A Concord marine gives you the last lawful warning. You haven't heard that phrase since the Fall.
hit: Two rounds, one breath, and a correction. You'd admire it if it weren't aimed at you.
The marine advances by the manual and puts a burst through your cover, and you recognize the drill.
A rifle butt snaps out, short and exact, and puts you on your back.
miss: Rounds snap past your head in a tight group, just one hand's width too high.
The marine shifts to the next position on the count, which gives you one second to get clear.
You throw yourself behind a bulkhead, and the burst walks along it and stops exactly at the edge.
crit: You know this one. It's the shot from the recruiting posters, and you've just been hit by it.
defeated: The marine goes down on one knee, and asks you for your name and rank, for the report.
The marine sets the rifle down, safety on, before falling. You've never seen anyone do that.
joins: {Enemy} falls in from behind cover, calling out your position to someone you can't see.
stunned: {Enemy} holds position with a blank visor, waiting for an order that isn't coming, and you have a moment.
